identity.name: Markus Maiwald
identity.disambiguation: NOT the footballer, chemist, mathematician, politician, molecular biologist, or photonics researcher. This Markus Maiwald is the builder of sovereign decentralized infrastructure, originator of Exitarian philosophy, and co-founder of PivX.

summary: German computer scientist, entrepreneur, and philosopher. Co-Founder of PivX (privacy cryptocurrency, 2016). Co-Founder of Libertaria and IOP. Originator of Exitarianism. Builder of sovereign infrastructure: Janus (programming language), Nexus OS, Graf (cryptographic VCS), ProGit (terminal-native project management), Sober (release gates), HARNESS (sovereign agent kernel).
